scope_summary: Implement all missing interpreter functionality: bitwise (`&`, `|`, `^`, `<<`, `>>`), logical (`&&`, `||`), unary `Not` and `Neg`, `Len` (array/slice length), `Discriminant` (enum variant index), `SwitchInt` with >2 targets, `Aggregate` (tuples, arrays, ADTs), and nested projection writes (`write_through_projections_with_locals`). name: Parser: index expressions, or‑patterns, range patterns, slice patterns
scope_summary: Add parsing support for `arr[0]` (`SyntaxKind::IndexExpr`). Add pattern parsing for `PatOr` (`|`), `PatRange` (`..`, `..=`), and `PatSlice` (`[a, b, .., c]`). Update `glyim-syntax` with new kinds. Add error recovery for malformed patterns and missing brackets.

name: Builtin macros: file!, line!, column!, env!, include!, concat!, stringify!
scope_summary: Implement all builtin macros in `expander/mod.rs`. Use `Span` information for `file!`, `line!`, `column!`. Use `std::env::var` for `env!`. Use `std::fs::read_to_string` for `include!`. Implement token concatenation for `concat!`. Implement `stringify!` to convert token stream to string literal. Add diagnostics for missing environment variables or files.

tests.W2-C02-T02: `line!()` expands to integer literal with correct line number

name: MIR lowering: index, or‑patterns, ranges, slices, guards, struct/spread
scope_summary: Complete MIR lowering for all HIR nodes: `Expr::Index` → `Place` with `ProjectionElem::Index`. `Pat::Or` → `SwitchInt` over discriminant values. `Pat::Range` → `SwitchInt` for small ranges, comparison chain for large. `Pat::Slice` → length checks and indexed binds. Match guards → conditional branch after pattern test. `Expr::Struct` → `Rvalue::Aggregate` with spread via field copies. Ensure all bindings produce correct locals.
